text:
alex: ok kicking off a short thread to lock down mini-pilot acceptance criteria for the Optimize toolkit (batching + cache + quant recs + eval alerts). want to keep scope tiny and measurable.
hema: agree. focus: 1) batching policy suggestions 2) prefix/KV caching visibility 3) quantization recommendation flow 4) eval-triggered alert prototype
sophie: +1. for the pilot we should have clear success metrics per area, otherwise we end up with vague "helpful" feedback
marta: customers asking for "recommendations they can trust" — we need thresholds and a simple UI to approve recs in pilot
alex: proposal (very lean):
- batching: deliver per-app suggested batch sizes + expected latency delta (p50/p95)
- cache: show potential hit-rate uplift from prefix caching and a way to opt-in per-route
- quant: suggest model/precision combos with estimated cost savings and small eval delta
- alerts: simple eval-triggered alert that fires when quality drops > 3% on a tracked prompt set
tom: sounds good. concretely, launch gate = pass on 3 checks: latency SLO intact, cost reduction >= 8% for quant/batch aggregate, false-alert rate < 10% for eval alerts
sophie: can we be more specific on latency SLO? suggest no more than +10ms p95 compared to baseline for batching recommendations
hema: and add a rollout plan: canary to 5% traffic for 48h, compare model outputs with shadow traffic, auto-roll back if eval delta > threshold
alex: agree. small config snippet for canary (will use our existing rollout service):
```
canary:
  pct: 5
  window: 48h
  rollback_if:
    eval_regression_pct: 3
```
marta: UX ask: the pilot recs should have a confidence score + simple explanation (e.g., "expected token cost -12% based on N requests; p95 latency +6ms") so PMs can approve
tom: ops ask: instrument cost delta and per-route token counts, plus an emergency kill switch in the console
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline started for branch optimize/mini-pilot -> staging
alex: open questions:
- what sample size for evals? sophie?
sophie: for rule-of-thumb, 1k prompt examples per critical route to get stable signal. if customers can't provide, use representative synthetic set but mark lower confidence
hema: timeline: 2 weeks to get first internal canary, 4 weeks for limited customer pilot
alex: prioritization: we should sequence work: 1) batching suggestions + instrumentation 2) caching visibility + opt-in 3) quant recs (non-blocking, can be async) 4) eval alerts (last, but tie to batching/quant outcomes)
marta: customer comms draft: "mini pilot offers automated recommendations for batching, cache, and quantization with safety gates and reversible rollouts" — ok to send to two early customers?	om: yes, but flag that quantization suggestions are advisory during pilot
alex: final check: launch gate checklist to track in the ticket —
- instrumentation (latency/cost) ✅
- canary config + rollback ✅
- rec confidence + explanations ✅
- eval alert prototype + false-positive estimation ✅
- customer opt-in flow ✅
hema: I'll create the ticket and add owners + a lightweight acceptance rubric. tagging folks inline for follow-ups: @sophie @marta @tom
alex: perfect. thanks all. will sync thursday 10am for status.
deploy-bot: pipeline succeeded: staging deploy complete
